ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-27) — no quarterly DPS fact since
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2026 (2025-06-29..2026-06-27) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-27..2026-06-27
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-27..2026-06-27

dividend_yield.basis: FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-27) — no quarterly DPS fact since

dividend_yield.note: FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-27) — no quarterly DPS fact since

notes: quarterly DPS (declared): 1 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2023-09-30: 0.5 (filed 2023-11-01) used, not 0.51 (filed 2024-10-30) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2023-07-02..2023-12-30 − 2023-10-01..2023-12-30)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context
dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-03-29 and 2025-09-27) — FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-27) — no quarterly DPS fact since
